@messagesTitle.description: Title of the messages tab (the list of chats).

messagesCheckConnection: Check your connection and try again
messagesNoChatsSubtitle: Tap the new message button to start chatting with friends!

@messagesNothingMatches.description: Empty search result in the chat list, a chat and the new-chat sheet.

@messagesYouPrefix.description: Chat list preview when the user sent the last message.

@messagesYesterday.description: Day separator in a chat and the time label in the chat list.

@messagesChatFallbackTitle.description: Chat header title while the friend's name is not known yet.

@messagesEmptySubtitle.description: Empty chat. The name cannot be inflected: phrase it so the name stays in its base form.

@messagesNotificationsMuted.description: Small line under the friend's name in a muted chat. Keep it short.

@messagesChatOptions.description: Accessibility label of the chat menu button.

@messagesReceiptSending.description: Receipt under the user's newest message.

@messagesReceiptRead.description: Receipt: the friend has read the message (past participle).

@messagesScrollToLatest.description: Accessibility label of the round button that jumps to the newest message.

messagesCantSend: You can't send messages to this user
messagesCapsuleUnavailable: This capsule is no longer available
messagesClearConfirmTitle: Are you sure you want to clear chat history?

@messagesClearConfirm.description: Confirm button of the clear-history dialog.

@messagesMenuSearch.description: Chat menu item. Menu items are one short line (about 22 characters at most).

@messagesOpenCapsule.description: Accessibility label of a capsule's photo in a chat.

@messagesCapsuleLabel.description: Small label on the photo of a capsule sent in a chat.

@messagesSendCapsule.description: Accessibility label of the capsule button next to the message field.

@messagesSend.description: Accessibility label of the send button.

messagesNewChatNoFriendsSubtitle: Add some friends to start chatting!

@messagesStartChatWith.description: Accessibility label of a friend in the new-chat sheet.

messagesDeleteConfirmTitle: Delete this message for both of you?

@messagesPhoto.description: A photo message: chat list preview and quotes (after a camera sign).

@messagesSendPhoto.description: Screen reader label and title of the chat input's photo button.

@messagesChoosePhoto.description: Menu item: pick a photo from the phone's gallery for the chat.

@messagesTakePhoto.description: Menu item: take a photo with the camera for the chat.

@messagesPhotoCaption.description: Hint of the caption field under a photo about to be sent.

@messagesPhotoUnreadable.description: Shown when the chosen file cannot be read as a picture.

@messagesOpenPhoto.description: Screen reader label of a photo in a chat bubble.

@messagesTyping.description: Under the friend's name in the chat header while they type (animated dots follow).

messagesGroupFailed: Something went wrong with the group. Try again.

@messagesGroupFailed.description: Shown when creating, renaming, leaving or inviting to a group fails.

messagesGroupNameTooLong: A group name can have at most 60 characters

@messagesGroupNameTooLong.description: Shown when a group name is longer than allowed.

@messagesNewGroup.description: Button at the top of the new-chat sheet; title of the page that makes a group.

@messagesGroupName.description: Hint of the group name field.

@messagesGroupWho.description: Title above the friends to pick for a new group.

@messagesGroupNeedsName.description: Shown when creating a group without a name.

@messagesGroupNeedsPeople.description: Shown when creating a group without picking friends.

messagesGroupTooMany: A group has at most 20 people

@messagesGroupTooMany.description: Shown when more people are picked than a group holds.

@messagesGroupMembers.description: Under a group's name in its header.

@messagesTypingName.description: Group header while one person types (animated dots follow).

@messagesTypingMany.description: Group header while several people type (animated dots follow).

messagesGroupLeaveConfirm: Leave “{name}”? Its messages will no longer show here.

@messagesGroupRename.description: Group menu item and title of the rename card.

@messagesGroupAddPeople.description: Group menu item and title of the page that invites friends.

@messagesGroupMembersTitle.description: Group menu item and title of the members list.

messagesGroupInvited: Invited. Your friends join in a moment.

@messagesGroupInvited.description: Shown after inviting friends to a group (the server adds them).

messagesGroupLeft: You are no longer in this group

@messagesGroupLeft.description: Instead of the message field when the user is no longer in the group.

@messagesGroupHello.description: Empty state of a new group chat.

@messagesOpenGroup.description: Screen reader label of a group in the chat list.

@messagesGroupSave.description: Button saving a group's new name.
